name: B-spline Field Interpolation
aliases: Cubic B-spline interpolation for heterogeneous refractive fields
definition: A method for function interpolation using cubic B-splines, defined by a grid of control points and weights, where shape functions have local influence.
summary: B-spline Field Interpolation evaluates continuous fields from discrete control points using cubic B-splines, offering smoother gradients and higher-order continuity than linear voxel interpolation.
